name: mahalle-ye-mehrabani
description: «محله‌ی مهربانی» — offline-first Persian RTL turn-based RPG vertical slice for ages 3-7.

scripts.build: npm --ignore-scripts run validate:content && npm run validate:assets && tsc -b && vite build && npm run check:budgets && npm run check:deploy
scripts.sample:scene:previews: npm run example:scene-build && npm --prefix examples/scene-demo run previews
scripts.sample:phase5:previews: npm run example:scene-build && npm --prefix examples/scene-demo run previews:phase5
scripts.sample:garden:dev: npm run framework:build && npm --prefix examples/garden-adventure run dev
scripts.sample:garden:build: npm run framework:build && npm --prefix examples/garden-adventure run build
scripts.sample:garden:test: npm run framework:build && npm --prefix examples/garden-adventure run test
scripts.sample:garden:e2e: npm run sample:garden:build && npm --prefix examples/garden-adventure run test:e2e
scripts.sample:garden:previews: npm run sample:garden:build && npm --prefix examples/garden-adventure run previews
scripts.framework:check: npm run framework:core:check && npm run framework:narrative:check && npm run framework:gameplay:check
scripts.framework:build: npm run build --workspace=packages/core && npm run build --workspace=packages/narrative && npm run framework:gameplay:build
scripts.framework:test:prepared: npm --ignore-scripts --workspace=packages/core run test && npm --ignore-scripts --workspace=packages/narrative run test && npm run framework:gameplay:test:prepared
scripts.framework:test: npm run framework:check && npm run framework:build && npm run framework:test:prepared
scripts.framework:narrative-consumer: npm run framework:check && npm run framework:build && node scripts/check-framework-narrative-consumer.mjs
scripts.framework:gameplay-consumer: npm run framework:check && npm run framework:build && node scripts/check-framework-gameplay-consumer.mjs
scripts.framework:pack: npm run framework:check && npm run framework:build && npm pack --ignore-scripts --workspace=packages/core
scripts.framework:consumer: npm run framework:check && npm run framework:build && node scripts/check-framework-consumer.mjs
scripts.framework:scene-consumer: npm run framework:check && npm run framework:build && node scripts/check-framework-scene-consumer.mjs
scripts.framework:garden-consumer: npm run framework:check && npm run framework:build && node scripts/check-framework-garden-consumer.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run roadmap:check && npm run lint && npm run models:import:test && npm run framework:check && npm run framework:build && npm --ignore-scripts run framework:test:prepared && npm --ignore-scripts run framework:narrative-consumer:prepared && npm --ignore-scripts run typecheck && npm --ignore-scripts run test && npm --ignore-scripts run build && npm --ignore-scripts run example:build && npm --ignore-scripts run example:scene-build
